_why: The codex hook-trust advisory exists because a hand-started codex skips the h-mad gate and nothing said so. Every mutation here makes the advisory quiet or falsely reassuring in one spelling: a missing record read as present, could-not-check read as an answer, an absent `enabled` read as disabled, or the lines never reaching main().

mutations.name: codex-trust-checks-only-the-h-mad-gate
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-GATE-ONLY. Drop the gate-command filter and every hook in the file is checked, so a user's own hooks raise h-mad advisories the skill has no business raising.

mutations.name: codex-trust-unreadable-config-is-unknown
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-UNKNOWN. Swallow the config error as an empty record table and could-not-check becomes an answer: a missing or broken config reads as UNTRUSTED (or, with records, as trusted) instead of UNKNOWN.
mutations.find:
except ValueError as exc:  # M:CT-UNKNOWN
                lines.append(f"CODEX_HOOK_TRUST_UNKNOWN:{codex_config} reason={exc}")
                return lines
mutations.replace:
except ValueError as exc:  # M:CT-UNKNOWN
                records = {}

mutations.name: codex-trust-absent-record-is-untrusted
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-ABSENT. Default a missing record to an empty table and the one defect this advisory exists for -- no trust record, gate silently skipped -- reports as TRUST_RECORDED.
mutations.find:
record = records.get(key)
            if not isinstance(record, dict):  # M:CT-ABSENT
mutations.replace:
record = records.get(key) or {}
            if not isinstance(record, dict):  # M:CT-ABSENT

mutations.name: codex-trust-absent-enabled-is-not-disabled
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-DISABLED. Read a missing `enabled` as off and the measured HemaSuite record (trusted_hash, no `enabled`) reports DISABLED.

mutations.name: codex-trust-explicit-disable-is-reported
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-DISABLED. Never take the disabled branch and `enabled = false` reports TRUST_RECORDED, reassuring about a gate codex will not run.

mutations.name: codex-trust-advisory-reaches-main
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-MAIN-WIRE. Unwire the advisory from main() and every unit test still passes while the installed check prints nothing.
mutations.find: for line in check_codex_hook_trust(codex_hooks, codex_config):  # M:CT-MAIN-WIRE

mutations.name: codex-trust-hooks-env-override-is-read
mutations._mechanism: M:CT-HOOKS-ENV. Ignore the override and the suite reads this repo's real `.codex/hooks.json`, putting an advisory into every exact-output install-check test.

mutations.name: codex-trust-advisory-never-counts-as-an-issue
mutations._mechanism: Count the advisories into `issues` and every host that uses dispatch only reads `INSTALL: FAIL`; consumers read that line by substring, so the accepted gap becomes a failing install.

mutations.name: codex-trust-config-defaults-to-codex-home
mutations._mechanism: Ignore CODEX_HOME and the check reads `~/.codex`, which on an Orca host is stale: it reports on a config no codex here reads (measured 2026-11-08).
